text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"--"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- (English) 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '--' while note N1 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a case depth of 0.8–1.2 mm, but neither states the manufacturing stage at which the treatment applies. This ambiguity can cause the shop to apply heat treatment at the wrong point in the process, risking distortion or incorrect hardness. The designer should fill the heat treatment field and add the stage (e.g., 'after rough machining, before final grinding') to note N1.","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat treatment field and revise note N1 to state when the case hardening is to be performed relative to machining operations."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"-0.005"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D10","page":1,"quote":"-0.014"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20MnCr5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.08 kg"}],"comment":"Note N5 calls for an I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating finish, yet the g6 tolerance band on the threaded section (limits D9 '-0.005' and D10 '-0.014', total 0.009 mm) does not account for the added plating thickness. Plating buildup will push the feature out of its tight g6 fit, preventing proper assembly. The designer should either reduce the pre-plate size limits to leave room for the coating or add a note specifying retapping/reaming after plating.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the pre-plate dimension limits for the g6 feature to allow for plating thickness, or add a note requiring re-machining after surface treatment."}]}
